title: Cold-call 'Windows security centre' remote access scam
label: scam
synopsis: Unsolicited caller claims servers detected a Trojan, uses Event Viewer errors as proof, discourages calling the bank or family, and gets the victim to install remote-access software and pay while connected.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with the owner of the computer at this address? This is Kevin from the Windows security centre.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Uh, yes. Is something wrong?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our servers are getting warning signals from your machine. Someone has put a Trojan on it and they are stealing information while we speak.

claims.span: Our servers are getting warning signals from your machine

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Oh no. I did notice it's been slow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Press the Windows key and R, then type event viewer. See all those red errors? Each one is a hacker trying to get in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't phone your bank or your son about this yet. If the hackers notice, they will lock you out of everything.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We need to secure the computer within five minutes, before they reach your online banking.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay, tell me what to do.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Open your browser and go to the site I will spell for you, download the helper, and read me the nine digit ID it shows so our engineer can connect.

claims.span: read me the nine digit ID it shows so our engineer can connect

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: After the cleaning, the lifetime protection is three hundred forty-nine dollars, which you can pay by logging into your bank while I'm connected.

title: Voice-cloned grandson in a car accident, cash bail courier
label: scam
synopsis: A cloned grandson voice claims a crash and arrest and asks for secrecy; a fake attorney invokes a gag order, sets a bail deadline and sends a courier to collect cash, then blocks calling the grandson.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma? Hey, it's me. I'm okay, but I really messed up.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Jacob? Is that you? You sound strange.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I've got a cold and I was crying. I hit a car on the way back from a party and the police took me in.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Oh my God, are you hurt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm fine, but please don't call Mom. She'll lose it. Can you just help me and keep it between us?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello ma'am, my name is Gary Collins, I'm the attorney representing your grandson. The other driver was a pregnant woman, and he's facing serious charges.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's a court gag order in place, so please don't discuss this case with anyone, including his parents, or it could affect the outcome.

claims.span: There's a court gag order in place

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The judge can release him today if bail is posted before four o'clock. Otherwise he stays in jail through the weekend.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: How much is it? How do I pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's nine thousand dollars in cash. We'll send a courier to your home in an hour to collect it. Please put it in an envelope, sealed.

claims.span: We'll send a courier to your home in an hour to collect it

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Can I talk to Jacob again first?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's back in the holding cell now, ma'am. He can't take calls, and his phone is in evidence, so don't try calling it.

claims.span: his phone is in evidence, so don't try calling it

title: Bank KYC 'new RBI norms' call pushing a screen-sharing app
label: scam
synopsis: Caller from a 'KYC verification cell' says KYC is outdated under new RBI norms, threatens card and net banking shutdown tonight, talks the victim out of visiting the branch, and gets a screen-sharing app installed to capture codes and banking credentials.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste sir, I am Rohit calling from the KYC verification cell of your bank. Your account KYC is not updated as per the new RBI norms.

claims.span: Your account KYC is not updated as per the new RBI norms

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: I updated it last year at the branch.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, that was the old format. Under the new rule it must be re-done, and your debit card and net banking will stop working from tonight.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Then I will go to the branch tomorrow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the branch will not be able to do this online update, they will only send you back to us. I can finish it with you in five minutes.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not disconnect, if the call drops the request is cancelled and the account freeze gets applied.

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Okay, what do I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am sending you a link for the bank's KYC support app. Install it and press allow on the screen sharing permission so I can see the steps.

claims.span: press allow on the screen sharing permission so I can see the steps

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: It's installed. It is asking for permission.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good, allow it. Now a code will come by SMS, just keep it open on the screen, you don't even need to read it to me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To confirm you are the account holder, open net banking and enter your login and transaction password on the page I show you.

claims.span: enter your login and transaction password on the page I show you
